lens: weights (PROTOCOL_V3 Addendum I): one stake per sleeve
data: in sample only: price frames read with the row filter ts < 2022-01-01; official trades read with entry_time < 2022-01-01 (and exit_time < 2022-01-01 for every R read); nothing dated 2022 or later read, simulated or looked at
account: PLAIN SUM of the ten sleeves' one-position chains (synthesis_B's P0 convention, the same as the clock lens), kept the same throughout. No cap across sleeves. A trade's result = stake x R; stake = base (1 R) x the variant's multiplier. A multiplier 0 = the trade is followed on paper only; no stake ever changes a sleeve's chain.
units: R = multiples of the base stake (the money risked on one trade at stake 1); no compounding
clock: FP server time = New York + 7 h; server week Monday 00:00 - Sunday 24:00; a trade's result is booked in the server week of its EXIT; the year of a week = the year of its Thursday; every calendar week counted, empty week = 0

T2_price_frames.what:
12 decision times T (4 per out-of-fold year 2019-2021, entries of the U10 fp book drawn with seed 5, never on the day
after US Thanksgiving, where GOLD_FRI_PM's early-close filter is applied after the fact). For each T, every market's
in-sample frame is cut right after the decision (bars starting before T + 2 min: the entry bar and one more bar, which
the rules need to emit an order whose entry bar is T), the ten sleeves are re-simulated on the cut frames (FP costs,
3-spread refusal; nq_btc_follow's leader = the us100 frame cut the same way), the book is rebuilt from those trades
only (a trade not closed strictly before T is unknown), and the stakes of every decision at or before T are
recomputed for every variant (U10 and U8_noF1) and compared with the full run, trade by trade on (sleeve, entry,
side). The known trades of the cut world must equal the full chains (same exit, same R).
Output: results/r2/sizing/weights/truncation_T2.json

verdict: No candidate. None of the 15 declared variants raises the pooled 2019-2021 weekly Sharpe of the ten sleeves by 10 % at equal weekly swing (FP); the best, IV00 (inverse volatility, no shrinkage), gives +5.9 % (2.745 -> 2.908), down in 2019 (-14 %), +4.5 % with costs x1.5, +7.0 % without the F1 sleeves. Every MV, Z and D variant lowers it.
findings: Reference (ten sleeves, equal stakes 1 R, plain sum, FP, trades entered 2019-2021, 157 server weeks): weekly Sharpe 2.745 (2019 2.395, 2020 3.714, 2021 2.037), 3,981 trades, +555.8 R, weekly sd 9.30 R, 44.6 % losing weeks, worst week -12.54 R, longest run of losing weeks 7, deepest fall of the weekly cumulative R 21.0 R, 60.7 losing trades per month. Costs x1.5: Sharpe 2.490, +499.7 R (3,983 trades). Without the two F1 sleeves: Sharpe 2.597, +384.1 R (3,166 trades).

Per sleeve, 2019-2021, FP (weekly Sharpe annualised; R per trade; trades): nq_btc_follow 2.11, +0.088, 720; F1 btcusd 1.98, +0.274, 422; brk72 btcusd 1.67, +0.249, 420; F1 ethusd 1.38, +0.143, 393; noise30 1.37, +0.073, 609; brk72 ethusd 1.20, +0.124, 395; donch4h_stop 1.07, +0.191, 158; ocm4 0.83, +0.106, 377; orb_asia gold 0.79, +0.155, 348; GOLD_FRI_PM -0.37, -0.012, 139 (-1.6 R in three years).

The sleeves' results move a lot from year to year: brk72 and F1 on btcusd and ethusd earned +0.09 to +0.56 R per trade in each year 2018-2020 and +0.01 to +0.08 in 2021; nq_btc_follow -0.04 and -0.03 in 2018-2019, then +0.13 in 2020 and 2021; orb_asia gold -0.17 (2018), +0.16 (2019), +0.35 (2020), -0.02 (2021); GOLD_FRI_PM +0.07 to +0.09 in 2013-2016, -0.04 to +0.02 in 2017-2021 (FP).

The weekly swing of a sleeve differs fifteen-fold at the same 1 R stake: weekly sd 2019-2021 from 0.20 R (GOLD_FRI_PM, sd 0.22 R per trade: its trades rarely travel to the stop) to 3.15 R (orb_asia gold, sd 2.15 R per trade).

Correlations of weekly R (FP, 157 weeks 2019-2021): mean over the 45 pairs 0.109; donch4h~orb gold 0.61, brk72 eth~F1 eth 0.55, F1 btc~F1 eth 0.44, brk72 btc~F1 btc 0.40, brk72 btc~brk72 eth 0.39; nq_btc_follow -0.10 to -0.02 with the crypto breakouts; covariances make 50 % of the portfolio's weekly variance. The four crypto breakout sleeves' mean pairwise correlation: 0.63 (2018 from February), 0.52, 0.45, 0.15 (2019-2021).

A sleeve's past does not tell its next year: across the ten sleeves, the rank correlation between the expanding past weekly Sharpe (weeks closed before 25 December) and the next year's weekly Sharpe is +0.56 (2019), +0.10 (2020), -0.21 (2021); between past mean / variance of weekly R and the next year's weekly Sharpe +0.08, -0.22, -0.48 (FP).

Ceiling of the lens (hindsight, description only): the best static stakes in [0, 2] (F1 <= 1) chosen WITH the 2019-2021 weeks themselves raise the pooled weekly Sharpe from 2.747 to 3.423 (+24.6 %; without F1 +25.4 %); chosen year by year with hindsight +19 %, +35 %, +124 %. They put 0 on orb_asia gold and GOLD_FRI_PM and the most on nq_btc_follow and donch4h_stop. No weighting fitted on earlier years can beat that ceiling on these weeks, so one stake per sleeve cannot bring the four- to five-fold rise in gain per unit of swing that doubling a small account in a month with falls under 20 % needs (about 0.35 R per trade instead of 0.08, results/r2/stake/x2/x2.json).

PART 2 verdict (15 declared variants, all causal by both truncation tests): no candidate. Best: IV00 +5.9 % pooled (2019 -14 %, 2020 +7 %, 2021 +30 %), +4.5 % with costs x1.5, +7.0 % without F1. All 4 MV, 3 Z and 4 D variants lower the weekly Sharpe at equal swing (ratios 0.919 to 0.990, FP).

ideas_that_do_not_work.idea: MV00-MV75: stake proportional to the walk-forward mean / variance of each sleeve's weekly R (expanding window, refitted every 1 January on weeks closed before 25 December), shrunk toward equal stakes by 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, clipped to [0.25, 2], F1 <= 1
ideas_that_do_not_work.numbers: Pooled 2019-2021 weekly Sharpe at equal swing, FP: x0.938 / 0.953 / 0.969 / 0.985 (2.745 -> 2.575 / 2.616 / 2.660 / 2.705); down in 2019 and 2020 at every shrinkage (0.93-0.99); costs x1.5 x0.916-0.978, 0 of 3 years up; without F1 x0.964-0.991. Total R at equal swing +521.4 / +529.6 / +538.6 / +547.7 against +555.8. Why: GOLD_FRI_PM's weekly R barely moves (sd 0.25 R in fold 2019), so its mean / variance is 4.5 times the average of the ten (0.788 vs 0.176) and it sits at the cap 2 in every fold while it lost; after its 2018 loss (-9.5 R) nq_btc_follow gets the floor 0.25 (MV00) to 0.43-0.57 (MV50) in 2019-2020, just before +31.2 R (2020) and +38.3 R (2021); the crypto breakouts are favoured going into 2021, when they fell to +0.01-0.08 R per trade.

ideas_that_do_not_work.numbers: Pooled ratio FP x0.964 / 0.959 / 0.990, years up 0 / 0 / 1; costs x1.5 x0.957 / 0.997 / 0.972; without F1 x0.969 / 0.932 / 0.987. Z24 switched off 459 trades of 2019-2021 that made +56.4 R: orb_asia gold 123 trades +40.5 R (2019-2020), nq_btc_follow 268 trades +14.7 R (2019-2020), GOLD_FRI_PM 68 trades +1.1 R. ideas_that_do_not_work.idea: D4 / D5 / D6 / D7 (cluster lens weights redone at equal weekly swing on the plain sum): stake 0.5 + rank / (n - 1) by the trailing 91 / 182 / 365-day or expanding paper mean R per trade, F1 <= 1
ideas_that_do_not_work.numbers: Pooled ratio FP x0.972 / 0.981 / 0.934 / 0.919, years up 1 / 1 / 0 / 0; 2021 x1.019 / 1.073 / 0.820 / 0.724 (the longer the memory, the more stake on the 2018-2020 crypto winners); costs x1.5 x0.969 / 0.998 / 0.943 / 0.924; without F1 x0.940 / 0.950 / 0.906 / 0.902. The cluster lens's +4 to +13 % were expectancy per stake on the capped account: these weights load the crypto breakouts, whose high expectancy comes with high, correlated weekly swings, so per unit of swing they lose. D5 shortens the longest losing run (7 -> 5 weeks) and the deepest fall (21.0 -> 18.3 R) but earns +545.5 R against +555.8.

caveats: In sample only: entries and exits before 2022-01-01, frames cut while read; nothing 2022+ read, simulated or looked at. The ten rules were chosen on data that include 2019-2021, so these out-of-fold years are out of fold for the weights only: every figure is optimistic. The validation look, then the demo account, is the measure that counts.
Three out-of-fold years (157 weeks) judge; 15 variants were tried, so the best ratio is biased upward (IV00's 5-95 % bootstrap range 0.99-1.14 includes no gain).

The MV normalisation (divide by the mean of the ten ratios) was fixed in the declaration before any description statistic; it is carried by GOLD_FRI_PM. A median or capped normalisation was not tried: choosing it after seeing 2019-2021 would be post hoc, and the hindsight ceiling (+24.6 %) bounds every static weighting anyway.

Equal weekly swing scales all stakes by k (IV00 k = 1.99): raw stakes respect [0, 2] (F1 <= 1) but the effective stakes reach 4 times the base on GOLD_FRI_PM; on a small account stakes below the broker's minimum lot are skipped (Addendum E).

Account: plain sum of the ten one-position chains (synthesis_B's P0), no 6-position / 2-per-market caps, no compounding; the cluster lens's D4-D7 figures were on the capped account and by expectancy per stake, hence differ.

Z and D are state rules evaluated at each decision on trades closed strictly before it (no fitted parameter, no yearly refit), as the cluster lens defined D4-D7; MV and IV are refitted every 1 January on weeks closed before 25 December (7-day purge).
The F1 sleeves' in-sample results are inflated (scorecard fitted on these years): U8 without them is reported and gives the same verdict.

Costs x1.5: the whole procedure (chains rebuilt on the widened quotes, weights refitted on them, its own reference and scale). The FP frames' spread uses a day-median shape that is not causal; it affects fills, not stakes.

Per-year Sharpe uses the server weeks whose Thursday is in the year and the trades entered 2019-2021; the PART 1 reference table also counts trades entered in late 2018 that close in the first 2019 week (2019: 2.400 instead of 2.395).
